hooks.command: file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$file_path" in */internal/commands/*/generated/*_test.go) ;; */internal/commands/*/generated/*) echo 'BLOCK: generated file — run make generate instead' >&2; exit 2;; esac
file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$file_path" in *.go) gofumpt -w "$file_path" || echo 'WARN: gofumpt failed' >&2;; esac

file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$file_path" in */go.mod) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"go.mod changed: run make generate to regenerate commands, then commit the regenerated files."}}';; esac
